description.value: Rosemary Rocksalt is a Montreal-style bagelry on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver, hand-rolling and honey-boiling bagels before baking them in a traditional stone-hearth open-flame oven daily. The café serves a full menu of bagel sandwiches, soups, sides, and take-home grocery items and is one of three Lower Mainland locations. It is notably one of the few food businesses in the area that accepts Bitcoin Lightning payments.
